title: Trace span
description: One step of an agent run, one line of <venture>/traces/<session>.jsonl, after the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions (a span with a trace id, a span id, its parent, a name, a start and an end, and gen_ai.* attributes), so any OpenTelemetry tool can read it. The file is append-only: each line carries the hash of the line before, as the provenance log does, so an edited or deleted line breaks the chain. A provenance line written inside a span names it in its span field. Spans hold names, routes, sizes, times and tokens; inputs and outputs only when the venture turns on traces.content in naive.config.json. packages/naive/src/checks/check-traces.ts checks it.

trace_id.description: The run the span belongs to; every span of one top-level run shares it

span_id.description: This span, unique in its file

parent_span_id.description: The span this one ran inside; absent for the top span of a run

name.description: The OpenTelemetry span name: the operation and its target, such as invoke_agent strategy, chat claude-opus, execute_tool naive_write

kind.description: agent: an agent or subagent run (gen_ai.operation.name invoke_agent). model: one model call (chat). tool: one tool call (execute_tool). call: one Naive router call. judgment: one System 1 call or scored check, such as Jev. trigger: a file trigger firing

status.description: OpenTelemetry status: ok, or error with error naming what went wrong

error.description: What went wrong, when status is error

attributes.description: OpenTelemetry attributes: gen_ai.* for model and agent steps (gen_ai.operation.name, gen_ai.agent.name, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens, gen_ai.usage.output_tokens, gen_ai.tool.name) and naive.* for Naive's own (naive.route, naive.action, naive.venture, naive.ok). gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages, and any naive.input or naive.output, are kept only when traces.content is on

prev.description: The hash of the line before in this file, or genesis for the first

hash.description: sha256 of prev and the line's other fields, keys sorted
